div.div: صَارَتِ الأَرْضُ سُوَاخًا (L, K) and ↓ سُوَّاخًا (L) and ↓ سُوَّاخَى , (L, K,) or ↓ سَوَاخَى , of the measure فَعَالَى, (S,) said in the K to be a mistake, but the S is not the only lexicon in which it is thus written, (TA,) The earth became very slimy by reason of rain. (S, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
